PKD_MALAMPUZHA.desc: Palakkad in one easy day: Tipu Sultan's granite fort, the old Brahmin street of Kalpathy and a Jain temple, then Nek Chand's rock garden and the Malampuzha gardens below the dam.
PKD_MALAMPUZHA.itin:
9:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
9:30 AM — Palakkad Fort: Tipu Sultan's 18th-century fort with its moat, ramparts and a small Hanuman temple inside. (Free to walk the grounds)
10:45 AM — Kalpathy & Jainimedu: The heritage agraharam street of Kalpathy and the 15th-century Jain temple nearby. Lunch in town after, own expense. (Footwear off at temples)
2:00 PM — Rock garden: Nek Chand's garden of figures made from broken tiles, bangles and scrap. (Entry own expense)
3:00 PM — Malampuzha Dam & gardens: Lawns and fountains below the dam, the Yakshi sculpture and an evening stroll. Ropeway and boating optional, paid direct. (Entry own expense)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_MALAMPUZHA.gtk:
☀️ Palakkad heat: Afternoons are hot most of the year — we keep the gardens for the cooler late afternoon. Hat, sunscreen and a water bottle help at the fort and in the gardens.
🛕 Temples & dress: Kalpathy temple entry follows temple custom; the agraharam street is open to all. Footwear off at the Jain temple; modest dress at both.
🎟️ Tickets: Gardens, rock garden, ropeway and boating are ticketed separately, paid direct. Some attractions have a weekly closing day — we check the week before.
🚶 Walking: About 3 km of easy walking in all, mostly flat. Comfortable shoes; garden paths and fort ramparts are uneven in places.
PKD_MALAMPUZHA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_MALAMPUZHA.exc: Lunch; Garden, rock garden and ropeway fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PKD_MALAMPUZHA.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable walking shoes; Water bottle; Cash for entry tickets

PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.desc: A cool day in the hills above Palakkad: Pothundy dam, ten forest hairpins, then cliff-top views at Seethargundu, Kesavanpara, orange farms and tea estates.
PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Breakfast stop at Nenmara)
8:45 AM — Pothundy dam: A quick stop at the old earth dam at the foot of the hills, by the forest check post. (Photos only)
9:15 AM — Up the ten hairpins: A 17 km forest climb to Kaikatty, with stops at safe viewpoints. (Forest check post on the way)
10:15 AM — Seethargundu viewpoint: Cliff-top views over the Kollengode plains and a seasonal waterfall. (Short walk)
11:45 AM — Orange farm & Kesavanpara: The government orange farm, tea and cardamom estates and the Kesavanpara rock view. Lunch in the hills, own expense.
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.gtk:
🛣️ Hairpin road: About 10 hairpins between Pothundy and Kaikatty — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Vehicles are logged at the forest check post; we go up early and come down before dark.
🌧️ Weather: Best from September to February; cool and misty most mornings. Heavy monsoon rain can bring landslips on the ghat — we re-check the day before.
🍽️ Food & cash: Few places to eat in the hills — we stop for breakfast at Nenmara on the way up. No ATM up there: carry cash for entry, lunch and the farm shop.
🐘 Wildlife: Elephants and gaur sometimes cross near the estates at dawn and dusk. Everyone stays inside if animals are on the road; we wait.
PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Entry fees, jeep safari and farm shop; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PKD_NELLIYAMPATHY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash (no ATM up the hill)

PKD_KOLLENGODE.desc: Green paddy fields, toddy palms and the blue wall of the Nelliyampathy hills: Kollengode's old palace and lanes, two quiet dams at Chulliyar and Meenkara, and the Muthalamada mango belt.
PKD_KOLLENGODE.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
9:00 AM — Kollengode palace & lanes: The old palace of the Vengunad royal family, seen from outside, and the village lanes around it. (Outside view only)
9:45 AM — Paddy-field drive: Slow roads through fields and palms under the hills, with photo stops. (Greenest Jul–Oct)
10:30 AM — Chulliyar dam: A quiet reservoir under the hills — a walk on the bund and wide views. (Photos from the bund)
11:45 AM — Meenkara dam & Muthalamada: Meenkara's small garden, then the mango orchards of Muthalamada. Lunch in Kollengode, own expense. (Mangoes Feb–May)
4:00 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_KOLLENGODE.gtk:
🌾 Best season: Fields are greenest from July to October and again after the second crop is planted. Mango season in Muthalamada is roughly February to May.
📸 Photos & manners: The fields are private farms — walk only on the bunds and ask before photographing people. The palace is a private home: photos from the road only.
☀️ Heat: Midday is hot and shade is scarce at the dams. Hat, sunscreen and water make the day easier.
💧 At the dams: No swimming or climbing on the spillway at Chulliyar or Meenkara. Garden hours and access can change — we check the week before.
PKD_KOLLENGODE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_KOLLENGODE.exc: Lunch; Garden entry and fruit you buy; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PKD_KOLLENGODE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable shoes; Water bottle; Cash for small shops

PKD_DHONI.desc: A guided forest walk to Dhoni falls in the cool of the morning, then lunch on the way and an easy afternoon in the Kanjirapuzha dam gardens near Mannarkkad.
PKD_DHONI.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
7:45 AM — Dhoni forest trek: A guided walk of a few kilometres through the reserve forest with the forest department. (Guide fee own expense)
9:30 AM — Dhoni falls: Rest by the cascade in the forest, then the walk back down. (No bathing)
12:30 PM — Lunch on the way: Lunch at Kalladikode or Mannarkkad on the Kozhikode road, own expense.
2:00 PM — Kanjirapuzha dam & gardens: Gardens and lawns below the dam, with views of the Western Ghats. (Entry own expense)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_DHONI.gtk:
🥾 The trek: Uneven forest path with some steep, rocky parts — about 3 hours there and back. Not for guests with knee or heart trouble; children with an adult only.
🌳 Forest rules: Treks run only with a forest department guide; group size and timings are set by them. The forest may close in heavy rain or when elephants are about — we confirm the day before.
🩸 Leeches & rain: Leeches are common in the monsoon; socks and salt help. Wet rocks near the falls are slippery — no bathing, no climbing.
🚯 Plastic-free: No disposable plastic inside the forest; bags may be checked. Bring a reusable bottle; we refill water in the vehicle.
PKD_DHONI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_DHONI.exc: Lunch; Trek fee, guide and garden entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PKD_DHONI.carry: Shoes with good grip; Socks and a raincoat; Reusable water bottle; Cash for trek and entry

PKD_CJB.desc: Coimbatore is Palakkad's nearest airport. We pick you up at your door anywhere in Palakkad, cross the Walayar border with the papers ready and drop you at departures — or meet you at arrivals.
PKD_CJB.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Palakkad town, Olavakkode, Kanjikode, Chittur or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~65 km via Walayar: About 1.5–2 hours on NH 544 through Kanjikode and the Walayar border into Tamil Nadu, then across Coimbatore. (Interstate permit arranged by us)
Drop-off — Coimbatore International Airport: Departures kerb at Peelamedu, off Avinashi Road. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
PKD_CJB.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4 hours before an international flight and 3 hours before a domestic one. Coimbatore city traffic is heavy from 8 to 10 AM and 5 to 8 PM — we plan around it.
🛂 Border crossing: The trip enters Tamil Nadu at Walayar; the interstate permit and border tax are billed at actual cost. Keep a photo ID handy in case of a check at the border.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Coimbatore?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
PKD_CJB.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
PKD_CJB.exc: Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_CJB.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Photo ID for the border; Water for the drive

PKD_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Palakkad and drive you down NH 544 to the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
PKD_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Palakkad town, Olavakkode, Kuzhalmannam, Alathur or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~120 km on NH 544: About 3 hours via Alathur, Vadakkanchery, the Kuthiran tunnels, Thrissur bypass, Chalakudy and Angamaly — longer at peak hours. (Tea break on the way)
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
PKD_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 5.5 hours before an international flight and 4.5 hours before a domestic one. Thrissur, Chalakudy and Angamaly jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
PKD_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
PKD_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

PKD_SILENTVALLEY.desc: Kerala's last untouched rainforest: up the Attappadi ghat to Mukkali, then the forest department's own vehicle deep into Silent Valley to the Sairandhri watchtower and the Kunthipuzha river.
PKD_SILENTVALLEY.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Palakkad Junction or the KSRTC stand; breakfast at Mannarkkad on the way.
8:00 AM — Up the Attappadi ghat: Past the Anamooli forest check post and up the hairpins to Mukkali on the Bhavani river. (Motion sickness? Tell us)
8:45 AM — Mukkali reception: Report to the forest-department reception with your booking and photo ID. Our vehicle parks here. (Booked with Kerala Forest Dept)
9:00 AM — Into Silent Valley: About 23 km by forest-department vehicle to Sairandhri: the watchtower over the valley and, as the guide allows, a walk down to the Kunthipuzha river. (Forest trip paid direct)
1:30 PM — Lunch at Mukkali: A simple Kerala lunch near the reception, own expense, and a last look at the Bhavani river.
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Down the ghat by mid-afternoon, tea at Mannarkkad, then back to your door in Palakkad.
PKD_SILENTVALLEY.gtk:
🎫 Book well ahead: Silent Valley is entered only in forest-department vehicles from Mukkali, with limited seats each day. Book with the Kerala Forest Department before you confirm with us — we can help, and we re-confirm the slot.
🛣️ Attappadi ghat: A hairpin climb from Anamooli up to Mukkali — carry motion sickness tablets if bends bother you. We leave early to reach Mukkali before your forest trip starts.
🚯 Forest rules: No plastic, no music, no feeding animals; stay with the guide on every walk. Little or no mobile signal beyond Mukkali.
🌧️ Season & leeches: The forest department may cut short or cancel trips in heavy rain; we re-check the day before. Leeches in the wet months — wear socks and closed shoes.
PKD_SILENTVALLEY.inc: Private vehicle and driver; Palakkad–Mukkali drive both ways; Driver bata; No waiting charges
PKD_SILENTVALLEY.exc: Meals; Forest-department trip, entry and camera fees; Tolls and parking
PKD_SILENTVALLEY.carry: Photo ID and forest booking; Closed shoes and socks; Light rain jacket; Refillable water bottle

PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.desc: A night inside one of Kerala's best-kept tiger reserves: through Pollachi and the Topslip forest to Parambikulam, with jungle safari, giant teak and bamboo rafting on your reserve package.
PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Palakkad Junction or the KSRTC stand; across the border at Gopalapuram, breakfast in Pollachi.
Day 1 · 8:45 AM — Anamalai forest & Topslip: Through the Sethumadai check post and up the forest road to Topslip on the Tamil Nadu side. (Forest fees paid at the gate)
Day 1 · 10:30 AM — Parambikulam check-in: Report at the tiger reserve reception and check in to your stay inside the reserve. (Stay & package booked by you)
Day 1 · afternoon — Jungle safari: The reserve's own safari through teak and grassland — gaur, deer, elephants and, with luck, a tiger. Kannimara teak on the way. (Reserve vehicle · paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Rafting or nature walk: A guided activity from your package — bamboo rafting on the reservoir or a forest trek with a tribal guide. (As per your PTR package)
Day 2 · ~5:30 PM — Drive home: Check-out, back through Topslip, lunch in Pollachi, then to your door in Palakkad.
PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.gtk:
🎫 Book with PTR first: Stays, safaris and rafting inside Parambikulam are run by the tiger reserve and need booking well ahead. Book your package first; we plan the drive around your check-in and activity times.
🛂 Via Tamil Nadu: The road in runs through Pollachi and Topslip in Tamil Nadu; permit and border tax are billed at actual cost. Forest check posts log every vehicle and close in the evening — we arrive early.
🐘 Inside the reserve: Sightseeing is in reserve vehicles with guides; our vehicle takes you to your stay and waits. No plastic, no music, no getting out on the forest road; mobile signal is weak.
🌧️ Season: Heavy monsoon rain can stop activities or close the reserve for a few days; we re-check before you go. Leeches in the wet months — socks and closed shoes help.
PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palakkad–Parambikulam drive both ways; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.exc: Your stay and PTR package; Meals; Forest entry, safari and vehicle fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_PARAMBIKULAM.carry: Photo ID and PTR booking; Closed shoes and socks; Light jacket; Refillable water bottle

PKD_VALPARAI.desc: Across the border to Pollachi and Aliyar dam, up 40 numbered hairpins to Valparai's tea estates and rainforest, a cool night in the hills — and home the next evening.
PKD_VALPARAI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Palakkad Junction or the KSRTC stand; breakfast at Pollachi.
Day 1 · 9:00 AM — Aliyar dam: A short stop at the reservoir and park at the foot of the hills. (Monkey Falls only if open)
Day 1 · 9:45 AM — 40 hairpins to Valparai: The famous climb, with a stop at Loam's viewpoint over the Aliyar lake. (Slow, with cooling stops)
Day 1 · afternoon — Valparai & Nallamudi viewpoint: Lunch and check-in, then a walk through tea to the Nallamudi cliff-top view. Overnight in Valparai. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Puthuthottam rainforest: Rainforest where lion-tailed macaques are often seen by the road. (Watch from the vehicle side)
Day 2 · ~5:00 PM — Down & drive home: Down the hairpins after check-out, lunch at Pollachi, back at your door in Palakkad.
PKD_VALPARAI.gtk:
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Valparai is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit and border tax are billed at actual cost. An e-pass for Valparai has been ordered — we apply if it is needed and re-check before you go.
🌀 The hairpins: About 40 numbered hairpin bends between Aliyar and Valparai, taken slowly both ways. Carry motion sickness tablets if bends bother you.
🌧️ Weather: Cool and misty most of the year; heavy rain from June to August. Waterfalls and viewpoints can close in heavy rain — we reorder stops.
🚯 No plastic: Disposable plastic is restricted in Valparai and the forest; bags may be checked. Bring a refillable bottle; keep snacks in boxes.
PKD_VALPARAI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Aliyar and Valparai sightseeing; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PKD_VALPARAI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry fees and any e-pass charge; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_VALPARAI.carry: Photo ID; Light jacket; Motion sickness tablets; Refillable water bottle

PKD_OOTY.desc: The Nilgiris in two easy days from Palakkad: tea country in Coonoor, Ooty's gardens and lake, the highest peak at Doddabetta and Dolphin's Nose on the way home.
PKD_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door in Palakkad — about 150 km via Walayar, Coimbatore, Mettupalayam and the Coonoor ghat, roughly 5 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 10:30 AM — Coonoor — Sim's Park: Tea country and a hillside garden on the way up. (Entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Botanical Garden & Ooty Lake: Lunch and check-in, then Ooty's 1840s gardens and a walk or boat on the lake. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Doddabetta Peak: The highest point in the Nilgiris, best before the clouds roll in. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · late morning — Dolphin's Nose, Coonoor: A famous valley lookout on the way down. (Stay behind the railings)
Day 2 · ~6:00 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat, lunch near Mettupalayam, back at your door in Palakkad.
PKD_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🚂 Toy train: Want the Nilgiri Mountain Railway? Book on IRCTC early; we meet you at the other station. Seats sell out and timings change.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. The ghat has many hairpins; carry motion sickness tablets.
PKD_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Ooty and Coonoor sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
PKD_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and toy train tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

PKD_KODAIKANAL.desc: A star-shaped lake, cliff-edge walks and pillar rocks in the Palani hills, with the Palani hill temple on the way home — your own vehicle and driver from Palakkad.
PKD_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Kodaikanal: From your door in Palakkad — about 175 km via Pollachi, Udumalpet, Palani and the Kodai ghat, roughly 6 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Kodai Lake: A walk, a cycle or a boat round the star-shaped lake. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Coaker's Walk & Bryant Park: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains, then the gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 · late morning — Palani hill temple (optional): Darshan at the Murugan temple on the way down — by winch, rope car or steps. (Allow 2–3 hrs)
Day 3 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: Lunch at Palani or Pollachi; back at your door in Palakkad by evening.
PKD_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🎫 Kodaikanal e-pass: Tourist vehicles need a Tamil Nadu e-pass for Kodaikanal — we apply for it. Plastic is restricted: carry refillable bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🛕 Palani temple: Queues are long on festival days and weekends — tell us if you'd rather skip it. Footwear is left below; dress modestly.
PKD_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
PKD_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and temple fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

PKD_GURUVAYUR.desc: Your own vehicle for early darshan at Guruvayur's Sri Krishna temple and Mammiyoor, the Punnathur Kotta elephants and Palayur church — home by evening.
PKD_GURUVAYUR.itin:
5:00 AM — Pickup: From your door, hotel, Palakkad Jn or KSRTC stand; about 2 hours via Thrissur. (Early start)
7:15 AM — Guruvayur Sri Krishna temple: Darshan at 'the Dwarka of the South'; phones, bags and footwear to the counters. Breakfast after. (Hindus only · strict dress code)
10:45 AM — Mammiyoor temple & lunch: The Shiva temple next door, then a temple-town lunch, own expense. (Dress code)
12:45 PM — Punnathur Kotta: The temple's elephant yard in an old palace compound. (Entry own expense)
2:00 PM — Palayur church: One of India's oldest churches, believed founded by St Thomas the Apostle. (Optional · modest dress)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Back via Thrissur to your door in Palakkad.
PKD_GURUVAYUR.gtk:
👗 Dress code: Men: mundu, no shirt (a shawl is fine). Women: saree, churidar or long skirt. No jeans, shorts or T-shirts. Mundus and sarees are sold near the temple if needed.
📵 At the temple: Phones, cameras, bags and footwear are not allowed inside — use the paid counters. Queues of 2–4 hours on weekends, Ekadasi and wedding days; keep water and medicines handy.
🙏 Non-Hindu guests: The temples admit Hindus only. You can see the East Nada from outside, walk the temple town and visit the elephant yard. Palayur church is open to everyone.
🚐 Your day, your pace: Want an earlier start or more time in the queue? Just tell us. Add Chavakkad beach or Thrissur's Vadakkunnathan in the evening — ask for a quote.
PKD_GURUVAYUR.inc: Private vehicle and driver; Temple-to-temple drives in Guruvayur; Driver bata; No waiting charges
PKD_GURUVAYUR.exc: Meals; Offerings, special darshan & elephant-yard entry; Tolls and parking
PKD_GURUVAYUR.carry: Mundu / saree / churidar; Small pouch for medicines; Water bottle; Cash for counters

PKD_VELANKANNI.desc: A full, relaxed day at the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church and the shore — from Palakkad via Coimbatore and Trichy.
PKD_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (≈420 km via Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Via Karur and Thanjavur; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · late morning — Morning Star Church & museum: The church by the shore and the museum of offerings; lunch own expense.
Day 2 · afternoon — Nadu Thittu chapel: Where Our Lady is said to have first appeared; candles and quiet prayer.
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers, then sunset on the shore. (No swimming)
Day 3 · ~3:30 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town (We leave at 5 AM)
PKD_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 9–10 hours each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; the driver rests overnight. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
PKD_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
PKD_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Hat or umbrella for the sun; Cash for offerings and candles

PKD_KALAMANDALAM.desc: A morning with the masters at Kerala Kalamandalam by the Nila — Kathakali, Koodiyattam and drum classes — then a grand Namboothiri mana of film fame and the poet's home where Ottan Thullal was born.
PKD_KALAMANDALAM.itin:
7:15 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
9:15 AM — Kerala Kalamandalam: Guided visitor morning: Kathakali, Koodiyattam, Mohiniyattam and drum classes, the Koothambalam and the Vallathol museum. (Fee paid direct · weekdays)
1:00 PM — Bharathapuzha at Cheruthuruthy: The wide Nila river by the old Kalamandalam campus. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Riverbank · no bathing)
2:45 PM — Varikkasseri Mana: A grand Namboothiri family house at Manissery, seen in over 100 Malayalam films. (Entry own expense)
3:45 PM — Kunchan Smarakam, Lakkidi: The 18th-century poet's home at Killikkurussimangalam, birthplace of Ottan Thullal. (Small memorial)
5:15 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_KALAMANDALAM.gtk:
🎭 At Kalamandalam: Classes run in the morning on working days; we join the guided visitor programme, booked ahead. No visits on government holidays or in the college vacation — we confirm your date when you book.
📸 Manners: Photos are fine if they don't disturb the classes — no flash, phones on silent. Footwear off where students train; sit where the guide shows you.
🏛️ Varikkasseri Mana: A private family house still used for film shoots — closed to visitors on shooting days. The inner shrine is for rituals only; we see the courtyards and halls open to visitors.
☀️ Palakkad heat: Afternoons are hot — hat, water and sunscreen help on the riverbank. Easy walking only; a few steps at the mana and the memorial.

PKD_PERUVEMBA.desc: Soft Ramassery idlis for breakfast, the old Gurumadom on the Sokanasini river, Peruvemba's 200-year-old drum makers at work, and Kottayi's quiet agraharam — the Carnatic music village of Chembai.
PKD_PERUVEMBA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Palakkad Junction (Olavakkode) · Palakkad KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
7:30 AM — Ramassery idli breakfast: Flat, soft idlis steamed over firewood at a village tea stall, with chutney and podi. (Own expense)
9:15 AM — Thunchan Gurumadom, Chittur: A 200-year-old house on the Sokanasini where the poet of the Malayalam Ramayana spent his last years. (Footwear off)
10:30 AM — Peruvemba drum makers: Mridangam, maddalam and chenda shaped from jackfruit wood and hide in family workshops. (Buy direct if you like)
12:45 PM — Kottayi · Chembai village: The agraharam and temple lanes of the music village. Lunch on the way, own expense. (Quiet village lanes)
3:00 PM — Drop-off: Palakkad Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
PKD_PERUVEMBA.gtk:
🥁 Drum workshops: Peruvemba's makers work in family workshops — we arrange the visit ahead and you watch them at work. An instrument takes months to make; buying is your choice, never expected.
🥞 Ramassery idli: The village tea stall makes these idlis from early morning until about 11 AM; weekends get busy. Breakfast is own expense — tell us if you would rather eat at your hotel.
🛕 Homes & temples: Agraharams are living streets — walk quietly and ask before photographing homes or people. Footwear off at the Gurumadom and temples; modest dress.
☀️ Heat & walking: Palakkad middays are hot; hat, sunscreen and water help. Easy walking only, on flat village lanes.
PKD_PERUVEMBA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
PKD_PERUVEMBA.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Instruments or souvenirs you buy; Tolls and parking (private trips)
PKD_PERUVEMBA.carry: Modest clothes; Easy slip-on footwear; Hat and water bottle; Cash for food and shopping

PKD_EV_CHINAKKATHOOR.desc: Valluvanad's great pooram at Palappuram near Ottapalam: decorated horse and bull effigies carried in by the villages, tholpavakoothu shadow puppets, a line of caparisoned elephants and fireworks at night. Event dates: ≈Sun 21 Feb 2027 · Kumbham Makam (Estimate — confirm with the temple).
PKD_EV_CHINAKKATHOOR.itin:
1:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Palakkad Junction, KSRTC stand or Coimbatore Airport.
2:30 PM — Drop near Palappuram: About 40 km via Ottapalam. We drop as close as the police allow; walk to the temple ground. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — Kuthiras & kaalas arrive: Villages carry in tall horse and bull effigies with drums and dancers. (Find a spot early)
Evening — Elephants & panchavadyam: The caparisoned elephants line up to panchavadyam and pandimelam. (Main spectacle)
Night — Fireworks: The night fireworks over the paddy fields; we leave after the main display. (Loud · keep distance)
12:30 AM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
PKD_EV_CHINAKKATHOOR.gtk:
🐘 The pooram: The festival of Sree Chinakkathoor Bhagavathy temple, Palappuram, falls on Makam star in Kumbham. Villages bring decorated kuthira (horse) and kaala (bull) effigies; tholpavakoothu shadow puppetry plays for the 17 nights before.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: We expect the pooram on Sunday 21 February 2027, from the afternoon until late night. The temple fixes the programme — we re-confirm before your trip.
🐘 Near elephants: Keep well back from the elephants and never walk behind them; follow the volunteers. Fireworks are loud — ear protection helps for children and the elderly.

PKD_EV_KONGANPADA.desc: Chittur re-enacts its old victory over the Konganad army: the temple oracle leads the procession with sword and anklets, men in buffalo headgear stage mock fights, and the iron-pipe kathina crackers boom through the town. Event dates: ≈Mon 15 Mar 2027 · Konganpada day (Estimate — confirm with Chittur Bhagavathy temple).
PKD_EV_KONGANPADA.itin:
1:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Palakkad Junction, KSRTC stand or Coimbatore Airport.
2:15 PM — Drop near Chittur temple: About 15 km south of Palakkad. We drop as close as the police allow. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — The war procession: The velichappadu leads the procession with sword and ornaments; mock fights in buffalo headgear. (Find a spot early)
Evening — Kathinavedi: Rounds of iron-pipe crackers mark the victory; the festival winds down after dark. (Very loud)
9:30 PM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
PKD_EV_KONGANPADA.gtk:
⚔️ Konganpada: Chittur Bhagavathy temple's festival recalls a victory over an invading army from Konganad. It starts with Chilambu on Sivarathri; the Konganpada day follows the new moon of Kumbham.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: We expect Konganpada on Monday 15 March 2027 — the temple announces the day. We confirm the date and the day's timings before your trip.
🙏 Respect: This is a temple ritual — keep clear of the oracle and the processions; follow the volunteers. Kathina crackers are very loud: ear plugs for children and the elderly.

PKD_EV_NENMARA.desc: Two villages, one goddess: Nenmara and Vallangi meet at Nellikulangara under the Nelliyampathy hills with tall elephant pavilions, panchavadyam and some of Kerala's biggest fireworks. Your own vehicle, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Sat 3 Apr 2027 · Meenam 20 (Estimate — confirm with the Nellikulangara temple).
PKD_EV_NENMARA.itin:
2:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Palakkad Junction, KSRTC stand or Coimbatore Airport.
3:00 PM — Drop near Nenmara: About 30 km via Kollengode road or Kuzhalmannam. We drop as close as the police allow. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — Elephant processions: Each village brings its caparisoned elephants with panchavadyam and melam. (Find a spot early)
Dusk — Aana panthal lights: The towering lit pavilions of the two villages glow at nightfall. (Photo time)
Night — The great fireworks: Nenmara and Vallangi answer each other in the sky; we leave after the main display. (Loud · keep distance)
12:30 AM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
PKD_EV_NENMARA.gtk:
🐘 The vela: The festival of Nellikulangara Bhagavathy, shared by the villages of Nenmara and Vallangi, on the 20th of Meenam. The flag goes up on Meenam 1; the vela day brings elephants, melam, lit pavilions and night fireworks.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: We expect the vela on Saturday 3 April 2027. The temple and the two desams fix the programme — we re-confirm before your trip.
🎆 Fireworks: Stand where the police allow, well back from the firing ground; ear plugs help. Keep children close — crowds surge when the display starts and ends.
